top_signals.title: Yen Rallies as Intervention, BOJ Rate Risk Weigh on Wary Traders
top_signals.summary: The yen jumped sharply for a second day, reversing a month of gradual decline, as traders lifted bets on Japanese interest-rate hikes and were on high alert to the risk of authorities wading back into the market to boost the currency.
